author_or_account: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
title: LSHTM experts warn of health misinformation risks, call for new network
discussion_signal: LSHTM’s discussion warns that misleading health information across social media, apps, and AI tools can affect care decisions and population health. It argues that rebuilding trust requires accessible information that responds to people’s concerns rather than simply asking them to trust experts.
linked_research_question: How does health misinformation create an unequal practical-judgment gap between exposure, confidence, and safe care decisions?
limits: The post is an institutional warning and predates much of the target window
It does not measure misinformation exposure or decision outcomes
It describes risk and proposed collaboration rather than evaluating an intervention
